title: Marc Levoy - Lectures on Digital Photography - Lecture 1 (21mar16).mp4
summary: The first lecture in an 18-part series on digital photography from Marc Levoy's Stanford CS 178 course, recorded at Google in 2016. The series covers how digital cameras work and computational photography, with slides and assignments available on the course site.
why: HN recommends it as a free, serious introduction to digital and computational photography from a professor who helped build the early Pixel cameras.

quote.text: It's short and fun, I recommend it to all HN readers.
